title: 10 baby names inspired by ancient sages
description: Long before universities, libraries and online courses, there were sages who travelled, debated, questioned the world and passed their knowledge on to generations after them. Some explored the nature of existence, others studied medicine, astronomy, philosophy and spirituality. Their names have survived centuries, often carrying stories of curiosity and intellectual courage. If you would like your child's name to have a connection with one of history's great thinkers, these ten names are worth exploring.
